# ex: type wildcard in pattern (match.go:379-384)
ex {
	type T interface{}
	var x T
	Wrap(x) -> x
}
-- x.go --
package p

func Wrap(x interface{}) interface{} { return x }

func f() interface{} {
	return Wrap(42)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go

+	return 42
 }
